command: set -euo pipefail; SDK="${ANDROID_SDK_ROOT:-${ANDROID_HOME:-$HOME/Library/Android/sdk}}"; ADB="$(command -v adb || true)"; if [ -z "$ADB" ] && [ -x "$SDK/platform-tools/adb" ]; then ADB="$SDK/platform-tools/adb"; fi; test -n "$ADB"; test "$($ADB devices | awk 'NR>1 && $2=="device"{n++} END{print n+0}')" -eq 1; $ADB shell monkey -p link.localclimate.app -c android.intent.category.LAUNCHER 1 >/dev/null; sleep 2; echo '=== PACKAGE ==='; $ADB shell dumpsys package link.localclimate.app | grep -m2 -E 'versionName=|versionCode='; echo '=== FOCUS ==='; $ADB shell dumpsys window | grep -m2 -E 'mCurrentFocus|mFocusedApp' | grep 'link.localclimate.app'; echo '=== ERROR CHECK ==='; if $ADB logcat -d -v brief | grep -E 'FATAL EXCEPTION|ANR in link.localclimate.app'; then exit 31; else echo NO_FATAL_OR_ANR; fi; test -z "$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=no)"; git rev-parse HEAD
